title: 費馬恩海峽沉管隧道~Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel
focus: 沉管量產、浮運落底與框架接頭~Element production, immersion and frame joints
summary: 費馬恩海峽的官方工程頁列18公里沉管隧道，並記載2020年開始施工。本課以跨國道路鐵路共同走廊為背景，逐步檢查箱體量產、重量帳、海床支承、止水接頭和設備交付。未來營運效益與施工進度分開表述，不把建設中的設施描述為已完成營運。~The official Fehmarnbelt project page describes an 18 km immersed tunnel and construction beginning in 2020. Using a cross-border road and rail corridor, this course examines element production, mass balance, seabed support, sealing and equipment handover. Future service benefits remain separate from construction progress; the facility is not described as already operational.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 費馬恩同時服務道路與鐵路，教學比較先固定兩端接線，分開道路車程、列車時間及施工海域範圍。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Because Fehmarnbelt carries road and rail, fix approach endpoints and separate road travel, rail travel and the marine construction boundary. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=14.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=14.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為15.84 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=14.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=14.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 15.84 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把鐵路節時套到道路會混淆接線與停站條件。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Applying rail time savings to roads mixes approach and stopping conditions. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：核對兩種運輸模式各自的端點與速度假設。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Check mode-specific endpoints and speed assumptions independently. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 矩形沉管的框架受力~Rectangular immersed-box frame action
units.mechanism: 費馬恩沉管採矩形箱體的教學剖面，研究中牆將頂板分跨後的框架作用，明確排除圓形薄環替代。矩形沉管的頂板、側牆與中牆透過框架連續性傳遞水土壓力，不能套圓形薄環的膜應力。單向簡支條帶只能估計局部彎矩量級；施工浮運、落底、回填和使用期的邊界不同，支承沉陷、接頭剪力及裂縫寬度仍須分階段檢核。~Use a rectangular immersed-box teaching section and examine how internal walls divide roof spans and create frame action, excluding thin-ring substitution. A rectangular immersed tube transfers water and earth pressure through roof, walls and internal partitions acting as a frame. A circular thin-ring membrane formula is inappropriate. A simply supported strip estimates one bending scale only; flotation, placement, backfill and service change the restraints, requiring staged checks of settlement, joint shear and cracking.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為39.0202 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 39.0202 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。比對頂板及中牆應變，使用含支承剛度的框架模型核對彎矩分配，將落底前後量測分開。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Compare roof and partition strain with a frame model including support stiffness, keeping measurements before and after bedding separate. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 漏列中牆會同時改變跨距、彎矩及接頭反力。忽略中牆支承或不均勻底床會錯估正負彎矩，局部裂縫可能是邊界變化而非材料強度不足。~Omitting a partition changes span, bending and joint reactions together. Omitting partition support or uneven bedding misallocates positive and negative moments; local cracking may reflect changed restraints rather than weak material.
units.misconception: 矩形沉管可以直接使用圓環均勻外壓公式設計。~A rectangular immersed tube can be designed directly with a circular-ring pressure formula.
units.practice: 本案「頂板跨中彎矩」的交付需回答：比對中牆剛度變更前後頂板正負彎矩分配。把單條帶、整體框架及接頭模型分開提交，標註適用施工階段和受力方向，保留裂縫及水密試驗的獨立判定。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the roof-span bending handover must address the following evidence: Compare positive and negative roof moments before and after changing partition stiffness. Submit strip, whole-frame and joint models separately, identifying stage and load direction while retaining independent cracking and watertightness assessments.

units.anchor: 拘束溫度應變~Restrained thermal strain
units.title: 溫度拘束與構件裂縫~Thermal restraint and component cracking
units.mechanism: 管節量產的混凝土溫度歷程不同於沉放後海水環境，研究早齡拘束與長期降溫的裂縫機制。厚壁構件在水化升溫後冷卻，若相鄰構件或基座限制收縮，熱應變會轉為拉應力。抗壓強度達標不等於抗裂合格，因為彈性模數成熟、徐變、溫度梯度與澆置順序都影響實際拘束；完全拘束彈性估算只能當量級上限比較。~Production temperature histories differ from immersed seawater conditions; examine early restraint and later cooling as distinct cracking mechanisms. A thick element cools after hydration, and restraint from adjacent pours or its base converts contraction into tension. Compressive-strength compliance does not establish crack resistance because modulus development, creep, gradients and pour sequence influence restraint. A fully restrained elastic estimate is therefore a scale bound, not a prediction of actual cracking or residual stress.
units.model: 原創教學假設：線膨脹係數=1e-05 K⁻¹；溫差=26 K；彈性模數=25 GPa。σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=6.5 MPa。僅把溫差增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為7.15 MPa。邊界：完全拘束線彈性量級，未含徐變開裂和拘束鬆弛；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: expansion coefficient=1e-05 K⁻¹; temperature difference=26 K; elastic modulus=25 GPa. σ=EαΔT, GPa→MPa ×1000=6.5 MPa. Increasing only temperature difference by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 7.15 MPa. Boundary: Fully restrained linear-elastic scale without creep, cracking or restraint relaxation. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將內外溫度、養護時間與裂縫出現日期對照。記錄核心表面溫度及同條件試體成熟度，將裂縫位置與溫差、拆模及鄰段澆置時間配對，檢查熱歷程是否被遺漏。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare internal and surface temperatures, curing duration and crack onset. Record core/surface temperature and matched-cured maturity, pairing cracks with temperature differences, formwork removal and adjacent pours to identify missing thermal history. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只用最高溫忽略溫差及拘束，可能誤判裂縫原因。標準養護試體合格而現場過早冷卻，仍可能形成貫穿裂縫並影響止水；僅增加後續抗壓試驗無法重建失去的養護。~Peak temperature alone misses gradients and restraint and can misdiagnose cracks. Passing standard-cured specimens does not prevent through-cracking after rapid cooling, and more later strength tests cannot reconstruct inadequate curing.
units.misconception: 混凝土抗壓強度合格就代表厚壁構件不會產生熱裂縫。~Adequate compressive strength proves that thick concrete cannot develop thermal cracks.
units.practice: 本案「拘束溫度應變」的交付需回答：將內外溫度、養護時間與裂縫出現日期對照。澆置前核准溫度監測及養護方案，變更材料、拆模或澆置順序時重新檢查熱分析，將裂縫與接縫止水的責任一併交付。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the restrained thermal strain handover must address the following evidence: Compare internal and surface temperatures, curing duration and crack onset. Approve monitoring and curing before pours, revisit thermal analysis after material or sequence changes, and hand over crack and waterstop responsibilities together.

units.title: 浮運重量帳與姿態穩定~Tow-out mass balance and stability
units.mechanism: 費馬恩浮運教學情境把臨時封端、壓載和設備納入重量帳，研究同總質量但不同重心的差異。浮力由排開水體重量決定，總質量還包含設備、臨時封端及艙內液體。重量帳只能判定淨垂直力，不能證明浮運穩定；壓載液自由表面、重心位置、拖纜與波浪都會改變傾斜反應，落底接觸亦需另建模型。~Include temporary bulkheads, ballast and equipment in tow-out mass accounting and compare equal masses with different centres of gravity. Buoyancy equals displaced water weight, while total mass includes equipment, temporary bulkheads and liquid contents. A mass balance determines net vertical force but does not establish towing stability. Ballast free surfaces, centre of gravity, tow lines and waves affect heel response, and initial contact with the bed needs another model.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1025 kg/m³；排水體積=11200 m³；總質量=1.11356e+07 kg。R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3378.56 kN。僅把排水體積增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14640.4 kN。邊界：靜水剩餘浮力，不驗證傾斜穩性及自由液面；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1025 kg/m³; displacement=11200 m³; mass=1.11356e+07 kg. R=(ρV−m)g/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=3378.56 kN. Increasing only displacement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14640.4 kN. Boundary: Still-water buoyancy reserve, not heel stability or free-surface verification. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。以實際重量清冊和吃水測量互核，量測液艙水位及橫傾，檢查密度與體積是否採同一狀態。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces. Reconcile an itemised mass register with draught measurements, tank levels and heel, checking that density and displaced volume describe the same state. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只增壓載而未評估偏心，可能改善重量帳卻惡化橫傾。漏列臨時設備或自由液面會使浮力帳看似足夠卻缺乏回正能力，偏載也可能先造成局部接觸。~Added eccentric ballast can improve mass balance while worsening heel. Missing temporary equipment or free-surface effects can leave an apparently adequate buoyancy balance with insufficient restoring capacity and premature local contact.
units.misconception: 剩餘浮力為正就代表浮運姿態在所有波況穩定。~Positive residual buoyancy establishes stability in every sea state.
units.practice: 本案「剩餘浮力」的交付需回答：以吃水與艙內液位回查清冊，另查自由液面。質量清冊每次變更都重新確認重心和吃水，操作窗口依核准海事方案及量測決定，不由本課靜力式制定。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the residual buoyancy handover must address the following evidence: Use draught and tank levels to reconcile the register and separately assess free surfaces. Update centre of gravity and draught after every mass-register change; approved marine procedures and observations determine operating windows, not this static classroom equation.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷梯度~Differential settlement gradient
units.title: 基床變形與接頭轉角~Bedding movement and joint rotation
units.mechanism: 海床整平和後續回填決定沉管支承，費馬恩情境須把落底瞬間與長期固結分開。沉管基床將箱體荷載傳給海床，局部沖刷、回填不均與軟弱層固結會改變接觸分布。總沉陷小不代表接頭轉角小；相鄰管節的差異位移和支承長度才控制局部變形，施工量測須保留時間與潮位基準。~Seabed preparation and backfill determine support; distinguish first contact from long-term consolidation in the Fehmarnbelt setting. The bed transfers tube load into the seabed, and scour, uneven backfill or consolidation alter contact. Small total settlement does not imply small joint rotation; differential movement and support length control local distortion. Construction observations must preserve time and tidal datum because immediate placement and delayed consolidation describe different mechanisms.
units.model: 原創教學假設：差異沉陷=6 mm；基線長度=140 m。β=Δs/L=0.0428571 mm/m。僅把差異沉陷增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0471429 mm/m。邊界：小變形角變化指標，不是完整固結解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: differential settlement=6 mm; baseline=140 m. β=Δs/L=0.0428571 mm/m. Increasing only differential settlement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0471429 mm/m. Boundary: Small-deformation angular-distortion indicator, not a consolidation solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 配對海床測深、管節高程及回填時序。用管節水準網、海床剖面及孔壓變化交叉核對，將整體下沉與相鄰節轉角分開評估。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Pair bathymetry, element elevation and backfill chronology. Cross-check tube levelling, seabed profiles and pore-pressure change, separating overall settlement from rotation between neighbouring elements. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 落底後高程穩定不保證軟弱層固結已結束。只追蹤平均高程可能漏掉單側失去支承，接頭剪力與止水錯台會先於明顯整體下沉增加。~Stable elevation immediately after placement does not establish completed consolidation. Mean elevation can conceal loss of support on one side, allowing joint shear and gasket offset to grow before obvious overall settlement.
units.misconception: 各管節平均高程接近就能排除接頭差異變形。~Similar mean element elevations exclude differential movement at joints.
units.practice: 本案「差異沉陷梯度」的交付需回答：配對海床測深、管節高程及回填時序。將基床施工紀錄與長期水準資料連結至管節編號，差異變形先查基準和孔壓，再由設計者判斷接觸及接頭。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the differential settlement gradient handover must address the following evidence: Pair bathymetry, element elevation and backfill chronology. Link bedding records and long-term levelling to element identifiers; check datum and pore pressure before designers interpret contact and joint behaviour.

units.anchor: 止水壓縮餘量~Gasket compression reserve
units.title: 接頭壓縮與水密包絡~Joint compression and sealing envelope
units.mechanism: 連續沉放多管節時，接頭累積方向偏差和局部止水壓縮不同，研究幾何誤差如何傳到最末接合。止水條依受控壓縮維持連續接觸，接縫轉角、錯台、污染與材料鬆弛都會降低最不利點的接觸能力。平均壓縮量不能掩蓋局部脫離；全尺寸試驗的結果只對測試過的幾何、水壓及荷載歷程有效，幾何餘量本身並不是接觸壓力。~Across many immersed elements, accumulated alignment error and local gasket compression differ; trace geometry into the final closure. A gasket seals through controlled continuous compression; rotation, offset, contamination and relaxation reduce contact at the weakest point. Average compression cannot compensate for local separation. Full-size test results apply only to their tested geometry, head and load history, while a calculated geometric reserve is neither contact pressure nor evidence of watertightness.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。全尺寸接頭試驗分別改變張開、錯台與外水壓，記錄漏水起點與卸載後殘餘位移，對照材料批次及溫度。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check whole-route coordinates separately from joint offset and compression. Vary opening, offset and pressure in full-size joint tests, recording leakage onset and residual movement against material batch and temperature. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 全線位置正確仍可能有局部扭轉造成接頭漏水。扭曲或沾污的止水條可形成旁通通道，即使平均縫寬合格仍可能漏水；盲目灌漿也可能只轉移出水位置。~Correct overall alignment can coexist with local twist and joint leakage. A twisted or contaminated gasket creates bypass leakage despite acceptable mean width; indiscriminate grouting may merely move the outlet.
units.misconception: 接縫平均寬度合格就不必量測局部錯台及扭轉。~An acceptable average joint width makes local offset and twist measurements unnecessary.
units.practice: 本案「止水壓縮餘量」的交付需回答：分開核對全線坐標與每個接頭的錯台和壓縮。保存接縫幾何與試驗壓力的配對紀錄，由設計者核定允收包絡；驗收時不能把課堂的幾何餘量當產品認證數字。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the gasket compression reserve handover must address the following evidence: Check whole-route coordinates separately from joint offset and compression. Retain paired joint geometry and test pressure, with the designer approving the acceptance envelope; classroom geometric reserves are not product certification values.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 海上定位、岸上控制與水下落底量測必須統一基準，教學中辨認潮位改正與姿態的耦合。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Marine positioning, shore control and underwater placement measurements need one reference; distinguish tidal correction from element attitude. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3720 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0515803 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=3720 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0468912 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0515803 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 潮位基準誤差可使多個管節共同偏高而相互吻合。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~A tidal-datum bias can place several mutually aligned elements at the wrong elevation. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：用獨立岸基控制和姿態量測檢查水下位置。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Check underwater position with independent shore control and attitude measurements. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 擴散特徵長度~Diffusion characteristic length
units.title: 氯鹽遷移與耐久判讀~Chloride transport and durability interpretation
units.mechanism: 海水環境下的費馬恩箱體耐久課題由材料傳輸和接縫路徑分開討論，不能只以平均混凝土係數代表全體。海水或除冰鹽可提供氯離子，材料孔隙與裂縫控制其傳輸；鋼筋腐蝕還需要局部電化學條件。平方根擴散長度僅顯示時間尺度，並不是腐蝕門檻深度；表面濃度變化、乾濕循環、結合效應及施工裂縫須另行辨識。~Separate material transport from joint pathways in marine durability rather than representing the entire structure with one concrete coefficient. Seawater or deicing salt supplies chloride, while pores and cracks govern transport; reinforcement corrosion also depends on local electrochemical conditions. A square-root diffusion length indicates a time scale, not a corrosion-threshold depth. Surface concentration, wetting cycles, binding and construction cracks must be distinguished rather than hidden in one fitted diffusivity.
units.model: 原創教學假設：擴散係數=3e-12 m²/s；暴露時間=17 year。ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm。僅把暴露時間增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為42.0759 mm。邊界：特徵長度，不是腐蝕起始壽命或氯鹽門檻深度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: diffusivity=3e-12 m²/s; exposure=17 year. ℓ=√(Dt); 1 year=365.25×86400 s; m→mm ×1000=40.1178 mm. Increasing only exposure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 42.0759 mm. Boundary: Characteristic length, not corrosion-initiation life or chloride-threshold depth. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較未裂區與接縫鄰近區的含水和氯鹽剖面。以分層取樣的氯鹽剖面配合裂縫圖與電位量測，檢查擴散模型是否只適用未開裂材料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare moisture and chloride profiles in uncracked zones and near joints. Combine depth-resolved chloride samples with crack maps and potential measurements, checking whether the diffusion model applies only to uncracked material. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 接縫快速入滲若併入材料平均值，會掩蓋局部維修需求。把一次電位讀值當腐蝕速率會誤判剩餘壽命，裂縫快速傳輸也可能被平均材料係數掩蓋。~Averaging rapid joint ingress into bulk material hides local repair needs. Treating one potential reading as corrosion rate misjudges remaining life, while averaged material coefficients conceal rapid crack transport.
units.misconception: 擴散長度就是鋼筋開始腐蝕的位置和精確時間。~Diffusion length gives the exact location and time of corrosion initiation.
units.practice: 本案「擴散特徵長度」的交付需回答：比較未裂區與接縫鄰近區的含水和氯鹽剖面。保留取樣深度、含水狀態及材料批次，用多種證據解釋劣化；維修優先序依構件功能與實際病害制定。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the diffusion characteristic length handover must address the following evidence: Compare moisture and chloride profiles in uncracked zones and near joints. Retain sample depth, moisture and material batches and interpret deterioration using multiple evidence types; prioritise repairs by function and observed defects.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 道路與鐵路同走廊的應變假設不能混用，研究不同使用者、車輛和隔離狀態對通行時間的影響。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Road and rail emergency assumptions are not interchangeable; examine how users, vehicles and isolation states change movement time. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=92 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=542 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為587 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=92 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=542 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 587 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 共用一個步速會漏掉列車下車及道路人群差異。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~One walking speed omits detraining and road-user differences. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：各模式分開演練起始通知、下車與安全區轉移。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Exercise notification, detraining and safe-area transfer separately for each mode. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 量產管節需以編號串起工廠試驗、沉放位置與營運設備，研究修訂後材料紀錄是否仍可追溯。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Element identifiers must link factory tests, installed position and operational equipment after revisions to production records. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=106 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.3962 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=106 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.9057 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.3962 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 現場交換管節而未更新資料會使試驗證據指向錯誤位置。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Unrecorded element substitution assigns test evidence to the wrong location. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽選管節從材料批次一路追到竣工坐標和檢修表。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Fehmarnbelt immersed tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace a sampled element from material batch to as-built position and maintenance sheet. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「矩形沉管的框架受力」，再獨立計算「接頭壓縮與水密包絡」。原創教學假設：單位長載重=26 kN/m；跨距=3.15 m。M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m。僅把跨距增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為39.0202 kN·m。邊界：均載簡支單向條帶，連續框架及板效應另驗；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：初始壓縮=20 mm；張開量=4 mm；幾何公差=2 mm。c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm。僅把張開量增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為13.6 mm。邊界：單向幾何餘量，不是接觸壓或水密合格證明；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate rectangular immersed-box frame action, then independently calculate joint compression and sealing envelope. Original teaching assumptions: line load=26 kN/m; span=3.15 m. M=qL²/8=32.2481 kN·m. Increasing only span by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 39.0202 kN·m. Boundary: Uniformly loaded simply supported strip; frame continuity and plate action need separate checks. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: initial compression=20 mm; opening=4 mm; tolerance=2 mm. c_res=c0−opening−tolerance=14 mm. Increasing only opening by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 13.6 mm. Boundary: One-direction geometric reserve, not contact pressure or proof of watertightness. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2020 年公開記錄：費馬恩海峽隧道開始施工；此年份不是通車日期。費馬恩海峽的官方工程頁列18公里沉管隧道，並記載2020年開始施工。本課以跨國道路鐵路共同走廊為背景，逐步檢查箱體量產、重量帳、海床支承、止水接頭和設備交付。未來營運效益與施工進度分開表述，不把建設中的設施描述為已完成營運。本課把「沉管量產、浮運落底與框架接頭」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2020: Fehmarnbelt tunnel construction begins; this is not an opening date. The official Fehmarnbelt project page describes an 18 km immersed tunnel and construction beginning in 2020. Using a cross-border road and rail corridor, this course examines element production, mass balance, seabed support, sealing and equipment handover. Future service benefits remain separate from construction progress; the facility is not described as already operational. The course treats element production, immersion and frame joints as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 18 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 18 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2020 年事件：費馬恩海峽隧道開始施工；此年份不是通車日期。~2020 event: Fehmarnbelt tunnel construction begins; this is not an opening date.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=14.4 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=14.4 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=14.4 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 14.4 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「頂板跨中彎矩」：單位長載重=26 kN/m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=32.2481 kN·m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching roof-span bending: line load=26 kN/m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 32.2481 kN·m; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「差異沉陷梯度」：差異沉陷=6 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0428571 mm/m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching differential settlement gradient: differential settlement=6 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0428571 mm/m; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「止水壓縮餘量」：初始壓縮=20 mm，其餘輸入依單元，結果=14 mm；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching gasket compression reserve: initial compression=20 mm, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 14 mm; not measured or accepted project data.
